title: Interactive leaderboard explorer (static site)
context: Backlog (unscheduled) UX task for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Builds a static-site interactive leaderboard explorer so researchers can filter results by partner and difficulty stratum. It surfaces only the public, provenance-bound benchmark numbers (CI + n) and contains no PII. Honesty guardrails carry over: it shows trade-offs, not a single winner.
objective: Build a static-site interactive leaderboard explorer over the public benchmark results, filterable by partner and difficulty, with no PII and every number showing CI + n.
acceptanceCriteria: Static site renders the leaderboard filterable by partner and difficulty stratum, sourced from the provenance-bound results.
Every displayed number carries CI + n; no winner is declared; no PII is present.
output: A pull request adding site/ — a static interactive leaderboard explorer.
